[[Nicholas the Traveler]] }} [[Diamond Djinn Essence]] is a trophy from Diamond Djinn. == Acquisition == * [[Nightfall]] ** [[Vabbi]] *** [[Diamond Djinn]] *** [[Diamond of Ahdashim]] *** [[Shakor Firespear]] ([[boss]]) *** [[Thunder of Ahdashim]] ** [[The Desolation]] *** Diamond Djinn ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Diamond Djinn Essence#Drop research|here]].'' === Farming === Diamond Djinn are much sturdier than surrounding foes, making spike damage and interrupts very useful in preventing them from healing themself. ====[[The Sulfurous Wastes]]==== A group of 3 djinn spawn just north of [[Gate of Desolation (outpost)|Gate of Desolation]], which can include Diamond Djinn. ====[[The Hidden City of Ahdashim]]==== Djinn of all types can be found throughout the entire area, making it possible to farm all 3 essences at the same time. The secondary quest [[Gift of the Djinn]] increases their numbers, though it also makes it more difficult. == Collectors == {{:Wekekuda/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|13th June 2011 and 8th July 2013|The Hidden City of Ahdashim|1 [[Diamond Djinn Essence]]}} [[Category:Items requested by Nicholas the Traveler]]
